label: Hitron CODA56 DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem
description: DOCSIS 3.1 cable modem with 2x2 OFDM/OFDMA plus 32x8 SC-QAM bonding, presenting a single 2.5GBASE-T port off one F-connector.
notes: Datasheet key features: 'DOCSIS 3.1 2x2 OFDM/OFDMA', 'DOCSIS 3.0 32x8 Channel Bonding', 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port; user manual rates service up to 6 Gbps. Single wired port, no Wi-Fi, no voice - a pure bridge.
